steps.en: Configure the MCP client to launch the package
steps.zh: 配置客户端启动查询服务

steps.en: Discovers station data and registers railway query tools
steps.zh: 发现车站数据，注册铁路查询工具

steps.en: Provide travel date, stations and filters through the client
steps.zh: 通过客户端提供日期、车站与筛选条件

steps.en: Queries 12306 and returns filtered ticket or transfer information
steps.zh: 查询 12306，返回筛选后的余票或中转信息

value.en: An assistant uses railway query data rather than guessing train times
value.zh: 助手使用铁路查询结果，不再猜车次时刻
